capabilities: Scan notes for upper-case keywords, list callouts and open checkbox tasks
Filter and sort results by source, done state, and line, label, date or name
Jump to an item's line by click or next/previous commands
Mark items done by striking keywords or checking tasks, with undo
Build and refresh a cached whole-vault index with excluded folders
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a task manager; it also finds bare keywords like FIXME and list callouts, and only edits a line when you press its check button.
extras: Scanning is read-only and local: the vault index is a disposable cache in the plugin folder and "nothing leaves the vault"; the manifest carries the unreviewed-plugin notice.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view that collects TODO/FIXME-style keywords, list callouts and open checkbox tasks from a note or vault into one clickable list.

relations.evidence: "Import from List Callouts" copies them from the List Callouts plugin.
With the Vimrc Support plugin you can bind the commands to motions

summary: Sidebar panel that scans the current note or the whole vault for TODO-style keywords, list callouts and open checkboxes, and jumps to any item on click.
